abstract: A preliminary study was conducted to correlate vascular invasion with metastasis in testicular tumors. A lectin-immunoperoxidase procedure was used to identify the vessels. Together with standard hematoxylin and eosin staining, the presence of tumor cells in vessels was detected. Primary tumor specimens from 37 cases and retroperitoneal lymph nodes from 10 cases of germ cell tumors were studied. The results showed good correlations between vascular invasion in primary tumors and metastasis to lymph nodes in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, and between vascular invasion in retroperitoneal lymph nodes and the presence of other metastases. Eight of the 9 nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients with vascular invasion had metastases, and all 4 patients that had vascular invasion in the lymph nodes had other metastases. However, there seemed to be no correlation between vascular invasion and clinical staging in cases with seminoma in which retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was not performed. These observations, although based on a limited number of cases, warrant more extensive investigations.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘍における血管浸潤と転移の関連を検討する予備的研究を行った。レクチン-免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法で血管を同定した。通常のヘマトキシリン・エオジン染色と併せて、血管内の腫瘍細胞を検出した。原発巣37例と後腹膜リンパ節10例の胚細胞腫瘍を検討した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、原発巣の血管浸潤とリンパ節転移の間、およびリンパ節の血管浸潤と他の転移の間に、よい相関が認められた。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で血管浸潤を有する9例のうち8例に転移があり、リンパ節に血管浸潤を認めた4例はすべて他の転移を有していた。ただし、後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行しなかったセミノーマの症例では、血管浸潤と病期分類との間に相関はないようであった。これらの観察は限られた症例数に基づくものであり、さらなる大規模な検討が必要である。
